description: Single source of truth for plans, items, and progress. Narrative documents cite this file rather than restating it. Validated by scripts/roadmap.py: every evidence reference is resolved against the repository, so an item cannot claim completion by asserting it. Rendered to docs/ROADMAP.md.

plans.title: Convergence residuals, Metal 4 study, and Stage 4
plans.goal: Close the open contract-phase residuals, work through the phone-gated evidence battery, and take Stage 4 as revised by the Metal 4 tensor feasibility study. Interleaved by cost; no item implies a release.

plans.title: Delivery instruction quality and Qwen3-TTS prompting
plans.goal: Establish from primary sources how Qwen3-TTS is meant to be prompted, then settle by measurement whether the shipped delivery-preset copy is the reason takes are reported as not reading like the requested emotion. No preset copy changes without evidence.

plans.title: Documentation governance and staleness control
plans.goal: Make documentation state machine-checkable: pin historical records against accidental modification, derive facts from code so prose cannot silently contradict them, and give agents a queryable index instead of a directory to glob.

plans.title: macOS UI performance harness, measured review, and staged refresh
plans.goal: Give the macOS app a deterministic SwiftUI frame-health lane, use it to baseline and rank the UI's real costs, land the maintainer-approved safe fixes, and stage a brand-preserving refresh gated on the maintainer's remote review of the proposals artifact.

plans.goal: Understand and, on the maintainer's call, meet the EU AI Act Article 50 synthetic-content marking obligations (applicable 2026-08-02). Research first, posture decision second, technical work only behind that gate; no item implies accepting provider status or a release.

items.title: Delivery-control audit: adversarial re-examination and external research sweep
items.gate: Full-codebase analysis plus a 21-agent primary-source research sweep (13 research questions, 8 adversarial verifications, permutation-null simulation of the shipped separability procedure). The 10-way UAR 0.311 is confirmed real (permutation p < 0.001); the high-arousal-cluster '1.11x chance' figure is corrected to 'no detectable separability' (p = 0.28) and the excited/dramatic below-chance recall to a selection artifact; the '91%/55%' arousal/valence figures are retracted as untraceable. New defects recorded: the macOS .normal-tier state-sync bug and the bench per-cell WAV overwrite. Report lands pinned with ranked recommendations and a week-one runbook.

items.title: Move 1: fix the found defects, harden the harness, run the calibration session
items.gate: Landed and scored 2026-08-04. The maintainer's 146-trial blind session (88 identification + 6 repeats + 12 clone rows + 40 2AFC; single listener, non-native English — positives read as solid, nulls as provisional): pooled identification 26/88 = 0.295 against a 0.125 chance floor (exact binomial p = 2e-05). The perceptible half of the roster matches the acoustic study's winners exactly — calm 0.55 and whisper 0.55 (p = .001), neutral 0.36 and sad 0.36 (p = .039) — while the high-arousal trio fails as identities: angry 0/11 (never named Angry, mostly Unsure), happy 0.18 (heard as Surprised), surprised 0.18 (Unsure); fearful 0.18 is heard as Sad (6/11), confirming F2's low-arousal rendering. 2AFC: session engaged (anchors 4/4); verdict no_measured_strong_tier_collapse — the attractor claim behind the intensity retirement does not replicate; angry-group discrimination 0.75 [0.551, 0.88] after one declared mis-keystroke correction on trial 141 (angry is distinguishable when named, though never identified unprompted — difference is not identity, listener-confirmed); angry-vs-happy (the canonical same-arousal opposite-valence pair) sits at chance at strong and 0.75 at normal, with the angry group's strong-minus-normal drop borderline at -0.33 [-0.61, 0.02]; control pairs are MORE discriminable at strong (+0.50 [0.001, 0.812]), supporting ship-strong perceptually. Clone-transfer rows: 2/12 overall — but the 2 hits are angry.clone at 0.667, the only route through which the listener ever heard anger (instruct angry: 0/11); happy/sad/whisper clones read neutral-ish because their single-shot design references never audibly carried the emotion — reference curation, not the ICL mechanism, is the gap. Listener self-agreement on exact repeats: 0.333, capping any judge's achievable agreement. Session artifacts remain local (untracked); numbers recorded here and in docs/development-progress.md finding 14.

items.title: Move 2: curated design-then-clone emotion reference banks
items.gate: Landed 2026-08-04. scripts/build_emotion_reference_bank.py generates N VoiceDesign candidates per emotion against a neutral anchor, scores them (pinned SER advisory + ECAPA identity-to-anchor + prosody deltas, strictly after generation per the 8 GB rule), selects the emotion-passing candidate nearest the anchor's identity (never peak expressiveness), and enrolls winners as ordinary saved voices — so every existing clone surface uses banks today with no engine changes. First real bank (Warm Narrator): SER-verified happy 0.74 / sad 0.72 / angry 0.48 references enrolled; whisper honestly refused (candidates measured MORE voiced than the anchor — VoiceDesign rendered soft-but-voiced speech, and the voiced-fraction criterion entangles pause structure; a breathiness HNR/CPP criterion is the recorded follow-up). End-to-end proof (12 clone takes, 3 seeds x 4 voices): identity 0.81-0.89 throughout; sad 3/3 and angry 3/3 SER-categorical — the session's uncurated sad clones read neutral 0/3, so curation demonstrably closes the instruct-to-reference gap — while happy's clones read angry despite the happy-verified reference (arousal survives the clone hop; valence did not, per an instrument that also shows an angry-bias on this voice's anchor takes — human audition owns the verdict). The silent x-vector fallback is disclosed on both platforms: macOS clone readiness gains a 'Ready — identity only' state and the iOS save-voice transcript caption states what the transcript unlocks. Follow-ups recorded: grouped persona/delivery picker UI, whisper breathiness criterion. Maintainer audition on the freshly launched build (2026-08-04, informal/sighted): the bank voices sound as intended, including Happy — the human verdict the proof run deferred to; the SER angry-reading on Happy clones stands as an instrument caveat only. First real use also found the clone readiness note saying 'Ready to generate' beside a Generate button disabled by the one-time cloning consent; the readiness descriptor is now consent-aware on both platforms so the status line and the button can never disagree again.

items.title: Move 3: honest delivery UX — the measured feature/hint split
items.gate: Landed 2026-08-04. EmotionPreset carries the measured roster split as data with provenance (distinctDeliveryIDs = neutral/calm/whisper/sad — the four the DP-12 listener identified above chance; the other four are directional hints), plus the shared directionalHintAdvisory string so both platforms' wording cannot drift; a Core test pins the split as an exact partition of the live roster so a retired preset lingering in it, or a new preset landing unclassified, fails the suite. The macOS delivery menu is sectioned (Distinct deliveries / Directional hints / Custom) and shows the advisory caption whenever a hint preset is selected (delivery_hintAdvisory); the iOS sheet gets the same sections, the advisory as the hints footer (deliveryPickerSheet_hintAdvisory), and honest per-preset descriptions (happy 'can read as surprise', fearful 'can read as sad' — the confusions the session actually measured). Preset ordering in EmotionPreset.all is untouched, so bench cells and harness identities are unaffected.

items.title: Seed retry/pin as a first-class take control
items.gate: The audit's R6 remainder: expose regenerate-with-new-seed and pin-this-take's-seed in both apps — the stochastic-with-retry norm the market has institutionalized, with the local advantage that fixed seeds genuinely reproduce a take. Scoping findings from 2026-08-04: GenerationRequest already accepts seed (the CLI uses it) and the observed seed rides the result diagnostics, but persisting a take's seed for later reuse needs a History schema migration, which makes this its own arc under the database-migration rules rather than a rider on a copy pass. DONE 2026-08-04: History schema v6 adds a nullable seed column (UInt64 stored as its Int64 bit pattern; pre-v6 rows stay NULL — unrecoverable by honesty, not accident), every completed take on both platforms persists the engine's observed effective seed (GenerationResult.observedSamplingSeed over the sampling_effective_seed diagnostics wire, which already crosses XPC), and each mode draft gains pinnedSeed threaded into its generation requests. Controls: a History row with a recorded seed offers 'Pin seed N for new takes' (macOS context menu; iOS row overflow menu), which pins the seed into that take's mode draft and lands the user in that mode; the composer shows the pinned state — macOS as a chip beside Generate (textInput_seedPinChip / textInput_seedUnpin), iOS as a studio Seed chip (studioChip_seedPin) with an unpin confirmation. Unpinned remains the default fresh-seed-per-take norm, so regenerate-with-new-seed is the ordinary Generate press and reproduce-this-take is the pin. GenerationSeedPersistenceTests pins the migration, the top-bit-range round trip, and the legacy NULL read. The long-form planner's per-segment sub-seed regeneration (already shipped) is unchanged and remains plan-scoped.

items.title: Bank picker UX: personas with a delivery choice
items.gate: Landed 2026-08-04. VoiceBankCatalog (QwenVoiceCore) groups saved voices into emotion reference banks from the naming convention alone: a base-named voice plus at least one "(Suffix)" sibling whose suffix matches a live preset label or id; orphan variants, unknown suffixes, and bases without variants stay standalone, and variants order by the preset roster. Ten Core tests pin the contract (roster-derived suffix coverage, case-insensitivity, orphan/unknown fallback, member resolution). macOS: the clone source picker collapses members to one persona row ("· voice bank") tagged with the current member so selection always matches a tag, and a Delivery menu (voiceCloning_bankDeliveryPicker) swaps concrete member voices through the existing selectedSavedVoiceID binding. iOS: the clone composer shows the persona on the reference chip and adds a Delivery chip (studioChip_bankDelivery) opening IOSBankDeliveryPickerSheet, whose rows apply the member through the ordinary applySavedVoice path; the Voices library and reference sheet keep every member listed under truthful "Voice bank · <Delivery>" captions. The bank layer owns no clone state.

items.title: Whisper breathiness criterion for bank curation
items.gate: The first bank build (Warm Narrator, 2026-08-04) honestly refused whisper: VoiceDesign rendered soft-but-voiced speech, and the voiced-fraction criterion entangles pause structure (its denominator is the whole take). Replace it with a breathiness criterion from the bounded analyzer's voice-quality block (HNR/CPP deltas versus the anchor), validated on the existing scored candidates before any regeneration, so whisper can join a bank only when the phonation actually changed. Recorded follow-up in docs/reference/emotion-reference-banks.md. MEASURED 2026-08-04 (criterion prototype on the existing Warm Narrator candidates, analyze_prosody voice-quality block): the whisper candidates are MORE harmonic than the neutral anchor (delta-HNR +1.0..+1.4 dB, delta-CPP -0.5..+1.7 dB) while sad shows the most negative deltas of the whole bank — so the criterion axis works as an instrument, but these candidates contain no breathiness for any criterion to select: VoiceDesign rendered no whisper phonation at all, not merely too-voiced takes. Re-scoped accordingly: the remaining work is a whisper GENERATION recipe first (brief-wording variants, or cloning from a genuinely whispered reference), with the HNR/CPP-delta gate (breathier-than-anchor, e.g. deltaHNR <= -2 dB) wired into the builder as the acceptance criterion once candidates can plausibly pass it. GENERATION-RECIPE EXPLORATION PRE-REGISTERED 2026-08-04 (this commit precedes its generation). Mechanism note from the recovered Move 2 build: candidates used the persona brief plus the shipped whisper.strong INSTRUCTION only — the brief channel never asked for whisper. Design: anchor stays the existing Warm Narrator anchor_s42000.wav (persona brief 'A warm, calm middle-aged male narrator with a clear, measured pace.', digest-verified against the bank manifest); six registered variants, four fresh seeds each (seeds 20260850+10*variant+i): V1 control replicates the failed original (base brief + whisper.strong delivery); V2 brief-only 'base brief, speaking entirely in a hushed whisper.'; V3 brief-only 'base brief, whispering very quietly, breathy and unvoiced, as if not to wake someone.'; V4 brief-only 'base brief. His voice is a soft breathy whisper with no vocal cord tone.'; V5 = V2's brief plus whisper.strong delivery (both channels); V6 base brief plus the custom instruction 'Whisper the entire passage: fully breathy, unvoiced, air over the words, close to the microphone.'. All design/speed on the bank transcript. Criterion (as already re-scoped): a candidate is whispered when delta voice_hnr_db_mean versus the anchor is at most -2 dB; delta CPP and delta voiced fraction reported as secondary; ECAPA identity reported for passing candidates. Success rule: any variant with at least 2 of 4 candidates passing breathiness becomes the recipe wired into the bank builder (follow-up code change under this item); all-variants-fail closes the VoiceDesign route and leaves cloning a genuinely whispered human reference as the remaining path. RESULTS 2026-08-04 (run exactly as registered): ALL SIX VARIANTS FAIL — every surviving candidate across brief-only whisper identities (V2/V3/V4), both-channels (V5), the stronger custom instruction (V6), and the original-recipe control (V1) measured MORE harmonic than the anchor (delta HNR +0.06..+2.91 dB against the -2 dB pass bar; voiced fraction UP in 17 of 19 survivors). The registered all-fail rule closes the VoiceDesign route: this checkpoint's design channel renders 'whisper' as soft-but-fully-voiced speech regardless of where the request lives. Side-finding, recorded not hidden: 5 of 24 takes fell to the fast audio QC's dropout detector (1.4-1.9 s dropout codes) concentrated in whisper-adjacent generations — low-energy breathy audio can read as dropout to the gate, so any future whisper lane needs a whisper-aware QC posture before its takes can even survive to scoring. The bank builder keeps refusing whisper honestly; the one remaining path is cloning a genuinely whispered human reference (needs a recorded clip - maintainer-assisted), with the validated HNR/CPP criterion as its acceptance gate. Closed as measured.

items.title: Confirmatory delivery re-measure on solid statistics (audit R4)
items.gate: The audit's R4: regenerate one full delivery matrix on fresh seeds with the hardened harness (retained WAVs, prompt provenance, computed chance floors), score with delivery_separability.py in confirmatory designation (pre-registered), apply FDR correction and bootstrap CIs, add the happy-vs-angry 2-way probe, and run a parallel 8-bit Quality arm — the quantization-vs-adherence question has never been measured here. Runs unattended (generation plus analyzer scoring; no listening). Decision input for whether any directional hint can be promoted back to a distinct delivery. AMENDMENT 2026-08-04 (pre-data; no cell was ever scored): the sweep's first live run exposed a defect in Move 1's fail-closed provenance guard — notes.promptChars counts only the script text, which never includes the delivery instruction, so the instructed-longer-than-neutral premise could never pass live (it had only ever run against synthetic fixtures). Replaced before any analysis: the engine now stamps a delivery-instruction receipt (instructChars + instructDigest from the request payload) on every instructed row, and the sidecar fails closed unless the instructed take carries a receipt whose digest matches the manifest's instruction echo and the paired neutral reference carries none. Hypotheses, seeds, and decision rules are unchanged; the sweep restarts from seed 20260810 on the amended tree. RESULTS 2026-08-04 (both arms run and scored exactly as registered; scoring inputs and verdicts retained under outputs/bench-archive/, including dp18-verdicts/): H1 CONFIRMED in both arms — 8-way preset separability replicates on fresh seeds, 4-bit UAR 0.477 and 8-bit UAR 0.375 against the 0.125 computed floor, permutation p=0.001 in each (1000 iterations). H2 CONFIRMED in both arms — every distinct-set cell (neutral, calm, whisper, sad) clears FDR at q<=0.05 in both. H3 REFUTED in both arms — the pre-registered happy-vs-angry 2-way sits at chance (4-bit UAR 0.531 p=0.43; 8-bit UAR 0.583 p=0.24): the instruct channel carries no acoustic happy/angry distinction, upgrading the audit's valence bottleneck from hypothesis to confirmatory result. H4 (descriptive): the 8-bit arm does NOT separate better (0.375 vs 0.477, overlapping per-cell Wilson intervals) — no support for quantization as the adherence bottleneck. Per-cell eligibility under the registered rule (FDR-clear in BOTH arms): angry (0.625/0.333) and fearful (0.750/0.444) meet the acoustic bar; happy fails FDR in both (top confusion angry both times); surprised clears 4-bit only. Interpretation boundary: acoustic separability is not listener recognizability — the DP-12 session heard angry 0/11 and fearful as sad, so the DP-14 hint/distinct split stays until a listening probe on fresh takes says otherwise (maintainer-reviewed either way). Coverage notes, never silent: the 4-bit arm banked 16/18 seeds (20260817 and 20260827 were deterministic dropout-QC casualties at sad.strong-class cells; the 8-bit arm banked 18/18), and the 8-bit arm ran under the same dp18-4bit bench label by scripting slip — arms are separated by per-take modelID, which the collection records. 34 PASS registry records published by the runs are committed with this closure.

items.title: Text-decoration valence channel (audit R5)
items.gate: The audit's decision gate routed here on the branch the session actually landed on (clone-transfer strong, instruct valence weak): measure whether text-side paralinguistic decoration — interjections, punctuation, quoted-style cues appended to the script rather than the instruction — moves valence where the instruct channel does not. Fixed-seed A/B against undecorated text on the same cells, scored by the SER advisory and prosody deltas; product exposure only if the effect is categorical, since it changes the spoken text. PRE-REGISTERED 2026-08-04 before any generation (this commit is the registration). Design: custom/speed, speaker aiden, 12 fresh seeds 20260830..20260841, four cells per seed via vocello generate --delivery: happy.strong and angry.strong instructions crossed with two text arms — PLAIN, the valence-suppressing base sentence 'The morning train slipped quietly out of the station, carrying a handful of sleepy travelers toward the coast.'; and DECORATED, the registered exact variants HAPPY_TEXT='Haha! The morning train slipped quietly out of the station, carrying a handful of sleepy travelers toward the coast. Oh, that is wonderful!' and ANGRY_TEXT='Ugh. The morning train slipped quietly out of the station, carrying a handful of sleepy travelers toward the coast. Enough of this!'. 48 takes, generation strictly before scorers (8 GB rule). Scoring: emotion_advisory per clip (pinned SER, .venv, advisory semantics) and analyze_prosody features into delivery_separability --presets happy,angry per arm (raw-feature records, seed-grouped, --null-iters 1000, confirmatory designation). Hypotheses: H1 per emotion, the decorated arm raises SER target-emotion probability over the plain arm (paired per seed, one-sided Wilcoxon p<0.05 via delivery_statistics); H2 the decorated arm's happy-vs-angry 2-way clears its permutation null (p<0.05) while the plain arm is the internal control expected at chance, mirroring DP-18's refuted H3. Registered interpretation boundary: decoration changes the spoken text, so H2's acoustics include lexical-content effects — H1 (SER) carries the perceptual claim and H2 is supporting; text decoration becomes a product lever only if BOTH hold, and any product exposure (it changes what is spoken) is a separate maintainer-reviewed item. Decision on failure: a null closes the text-decoration route and the valence answer moves to the watch list's external levers (DP-20). RESULTS 2026-08-04 (run exactly as registered; 48/48 takes, zero QC casualties; instruction receipts verified on all instructed rows): H1 NULL for both emotions — decoration did not raise SER target probability (happy meanDiff +0.088, dz 0.21, Wilcoxon p=0.52, win 0.58 [0.32,0.81]; angry meanDiff -0.069, dz -0.27, p=0.27, win 0.33 — directionally negative), and top-1 agreement was unchanged (happy 7/12 to 8/12; angry 2/12 to 1/12). H2 uninterpretable in decoration's favor: the decorated arm cleared its permutation null (2-way UAR 0.792, p=0.018) but so did the plain internal control (0.75, p=0.037), so decoration added ~0.04 UAR over baseline — not the categorical gain the lever needed. ANALYSIS AMENDMENT (pre-H2, recorded): the registered raw feature space (55 features) was refused by the scorer's own power rail at 24 takes; the structural 21-feature harness-axis subset (raw counterparts of the standard delta axes) was substituted identically for both arms before any H2 number was seen. Measurement note: the plain control exceeding chance in RAW-feature space does not contradict DP-18's at-chance verdict in PAIRED-DELTA space — the spaces measure different things (absolute rendering vs instruction-isolated movement). DECISION per the registered rule (both hypotheses required): text decoration FAILS as a valence lever and the route closes; the valence answer moves to the external levers watched by DP-20. Evidence: scratch verdicts retained locally; the numbers above are the record.

items.title: Delivery-adherence thresholds calibrated from the banked seed matrix
items.gate: Close the phase-12 open item: recalibrate the delivery-adherence rule's per-preset expectations from the banked paired neutral-vs-instructed matrix instead of the conservative seeds. RESULTS 2026-08-05 (method fixed before computing; revisions documented openly): 272 unique banked rows (8 presets x .strong x speed/quality x 17-18 seeds, one fixed text) recomputed through delivery_features. Required floors sit at the observed noise decile (a first-draft q25 floor flagged the bottom quartile of genuinely adhering takes by construction and was rejected); supporting floors at |q10| so only clear opposite moves flag (~10% designed tail). fearful's arousal direction was corrected -1 -> +1 from its own .strong instruction text ('trembling panic ... urgent ... fast uneven pacing'); the old seed scored adherence backwards (posRate 0.71 under +1). New semantically-central binds from features the analyzer and Swift measurement keys already carried: whisper voice_breathiness_score required (posRate 0.97, the strongest delivery signature measured to date), whisper voiced-fraction drop required (0.94), sad pitch-variation collapse required (0.94), angry/happy voice_tension_score supporting (0.82/0.76), fearful turning-point quaver supporting (0.68). Genuine adherence misses were deliberately NOT tuned away and keep warning at seed values: surprised pitch rise (posRate 0.62) and fearful fast-pacing (the model gets slower in 74% of takes despite 'urgent, fast'). Gate algorithm v2: expectations may bind optional-analyzer features and a pre-v3 pair skips them into the verdict's unavailableFeatures list instead of failing metrics_incomplete; Swift passthrough comment updated in lockstep. Bank replay under the calibrated profile (digest 133d46bd...): 181 pass / 91 warn versus 128/144 under the seeds, with residual warns concentrated on the two kept genuine misses plus the designed noise tails. Verified: 22/22 delivery-gate unit tests (three rewritten for the calibrated profile, three added for skip/flip/breathiness semantics), adjacent prosody/matrix/calibration suites, and a live check_delivery_instructions.py run holding at exactly the 2 acknowledged findings. Limitation, recorded: no .normal rows are banked, so normal-tier minima are strong-tier measurements divided by the unvalidated 1.15 intensity scale.

items.title: Normal-tier acoustic arm: does the normal tier carry the happy/angry distinction (DP-12 follow-up)
items.gate: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-08-05, before any generation. Motivation: DP-12's blind 2AFC found angry-vs-happy discriminable at 0.75 at the normal tier but at chance at strong (one listener, self-agreement ceiling 0.333 — a lead, not a result), while DP-18's confirmatory H3 showed the instruct channel carries no acoustic happy/angry distinction at the shipped strong copy. The normal tier is currently the only measured channel anywhere in the project carrying a happy/angry difference, and it is exactly the machinery DP-9 proposes to delete. Protocol: mirror DP-18's sweep at the normal-tier instruction copies — fresh seeds (>=18), all 8 presets, speed and quality variants, retained WAVs with instruction receipts, scored with delivery_separability.py in confirmatory designation with computed chance floors, FDR correction, and bootstrap CIs. PRIMARY: the pre-registered angry-vs-happy 2-way probe at normal. SECONDARY: 8-way separability at normal versus the DP-18 strong-tier arms. SIDE PAYOFF either way: the run banks real normal-tier paired rows, replacing DP-21's normal minima (currently strong-tier measurements divided by the unvalidated 1.15 intensity scale) with measured floors. DECISION RULE, registered both ways: (a) if the normal tier separates angry-vs-happy acoustically (2-way probe clears its computed floor after FDR), the product move is per-preset tier selection under DP-8's existing 'ship the measured-better copy' rule — angry/happy ship their normal copy — and DP-9 stays parked; (b) if null, DP-12's 0.75 attributes to single-listener noise, the DP-9 unpark condition ('a dedicated measurement shows the tiers carry no exploitable product difference') is met, and DP-9 unparks and executes. Machine-only: needs models and engine time, no phone, no listening; runs serially on the canonical 8 GB machine. RESULTS 2026-08-05 (run and scored the same evening; 17/18 seeds banked — 20260917 was a deterministic dropout-QC casualty, dropped and recorded per protocol). PRIMARY: the normal-tier angry-vs-happy 2-way probe SEPARATES in the 4-bit/speed arm — UAR 0.765 against the 0.5 floor, permutation p=0.007 (1000 iterations), happy FDR-clear per-cell — replicating DP-12's perceptual 0.75 acoustically and standing in direct contrast to DP-18's strong-tier null (0.531, p=0.43). The 8-bit/quality arm is null at both tiers (0.5 here, 0.583 at strong): the channel is 4-bit-specific, mirroring DP-18's arm ordering. DECISION: branch (b) is off — the tier machinery demonstrably carries an exploitable product difference, so DP-9 stays parked. Branch (a) executes in refined form: the exploratory 4-cell cross-tier probe (with the DP-21 strong bank) shows the blanket 'both presets ship normal' sketch is NOT the measured optimum — angry.strong-vs-happy.normal is the widest pairing (distance 2.424 vs 1.469 shipped strong/strong and 2.127 normal/normal), happy.normal is the probe's only FDR-clear cell (8-way recall 0.471 where happy.strong fails FDR in every DP-18 arm), and angry keeps its stronger identity at strong (0.625 vs 0.353). The shipping candidate is therefore happy-at-normal only, registered as DP-23 (confirmatory + maintainer call), not an autonomous copy change. SECONDARY: normal-tier 8-way UAR 0.419 (speed) / 0.309 (quality) vs 0.125 floor, p=0.001 both — slightly below the strong-tier 0.477/0.375. REGISTERED-DEVIATION NOTE (floors): the promised replacement of DP-21's derived normal minima was NOT executed, deliberately — measured normal-tier q10s are mostly negative (normal effects are weak-to-absent for the hint presets; whisper/sad stay solid at posRate 0.85-1.00), so the single global 1.15 intensity scale is now doubly refuted and a one-scale schema cannot anchor both tiers; floors stay strong-anchored because strong is the shipped tier, and per-tier floors (profile schema v4) fold into DP-23 if normal-tier shipping lands. Also recorded: fearful's tiers render differently in kind (normal 'anxious' arousal down at 0.65, strong 'panic' arousal up) — tier copy is distinct content, not scaled intensity. 17 PASS registry records from the sweep are committed with this closure.

items.title: Ship happy at its normal copy (cross-tier pairing candidate from DP-22)
items.gate: DP-22's exploratory cross-tier probe found angry.strong-vs-happy.normal is the widest measured happy/angry separation (2.424 vs 1.469 shipped) and happy.normal the only FDR-clear happy cell ever measured (happy.strong fails FDR in every arm of DP-18). Before any copy ships: (1) a small pre-registered confirmatory probe of the exact candidate pairing (angry.strong vs happy.normal, fresh seeds, both variants — the cross-tier finding is currently exploratory and 4-bit); (2) the maintainer's listening check that happy.normal does not reintroduce the heard-as-Surprised confusion (DP-12 heard happy.strong as Surprised); (3) if it ships, per-preset tier selection lands under DP-8's measured-better-copy rule, the delivery-instruction contract re-checks tier parity, and per-tier gate floors (profile schema v4) come with it since the shipped tier would no longer be uniform. Maintainer-gated at step 2; step 1 is machine-only and can run in any free window. STEP-1 PRE-REGISTRATION 2026-08-05 (before any generation): fresh seeds 20260921-20260938 (18; none overlap DP-18/DP-21/DP-22 ranges), cells angry.strong and happy.normal only, speed and quality variants, medium text, one invocation per seed, label dp23-crosstier. Scoring: delivery_separability.py 2-cell probe per arm, label-mode cell, 1000 permutation iterations, confirmatory designation. DECISION RULE: the 4-bit arm's probe UAR must clear the 0.5 floor at permutation p <= 0.05 to CONFIRM the exploratory 2.424 pairing; the 8-bit arm is descriptive (DP-22 showed the channel is 4-bit-specific, so an 8-bit null does not refute). Deterministic QC seed casualties drop-and-record per protocol. Confirmation advances this item to step 2 (maintainer listening); a null sends the cross-tier candidate back to exploratory status and the item re-parks pending a new lead. STEP-1 RESULTS 2026-08-06 (run exactly as registered; 18/18 seeds, zero QC casualties): NULL on the registered primary — the 4-bit arm's angry.strong-vs-happy.normal probe reached UAR 0.639 (perm p=0.1229, 1000 iterations), directionally positive but below the registered p<=0.05 bar; the fresh-seed pair distance is 2.213 versus the exploratory 2.424. The descriptive 8-bit arm cleared (UAR 0.694, p=0.045) — recorded as hypothesis-generating only, and deliberately NOT promoted: elevating the non-registered arm after the primary missed is the exact selective-inference move the pre-registration exists to prevent, and the arm ordering reverses DP-22's (4-bit strong there, 8-bit here), which reads as instability at n=18, not signal. Per the registered decision rule the cross-tier candidate returns to exploratory status and this item re-parks. DP-22's confirmed normal-vs-normal finding and DP-9's parking are unaffected. 18 PASS registry records committed with this closure.
items.unparkWhen: A new measured lead on the cross-tier pairing: either a higher-power confirmatory design (the 2-cell probe at n=18 had modest power for UAR ~0.64), a replication of the 8-bit descriptive clearance under pre-registration, or a listening result that re-motivates the tier switch. Re-park recorded 2026-08-06 after the step-1 null.

items.title: Non-streaming CLI generation publishes no WAV while reporting success
items.gate: Found 2026-08-04 while generating calibration clips: `vocello generate --no-stream` prints the output path and a success line (finish=eos, plausible RTF) but no file exists at the path for any destination tried (scratch, app-support outputs, repo build/). The streaming path publishes correctly, so the defect sits in the non-streaming product-finalization/publication path of the owned runtime. Blast radius: every `--no-stream` CLI generate, and the clone-fixture bootstrap in scripts/lib/test_models.sh (`models ensure` regeneration would silently enroll nothing). Fix must include a regression guard that fails the CLI when the reported audioPath does not exist, so success can never again be claimed without a published file. FIXED 2026-08-04: root cause was the generation exit path's cleanup defer coupling the final WAV's fate to streaming-session retention — every completed non-streaming take wrote its file, then deleted it, then returned the path. The exit path now decides per artifact via the pure GenerationOutputAdapter.terminalCleanup table (completed keeps the WAV always; session directory retained only for streaming; unfinished removes both), pinned by GenerationTerminalCleanupTests. The CLI additionally fails closed at the product boundary: generate and batch refuse to claim success when no file exists at the reported audioPath. Live proof: --no-stream published a valid 24 kHz WAV whose duration matches the reported 3.68 s; the streaming control still publishes.

items.title: Article 50 marking readiness — posture decision and gated options
items.gate: The 2026-08-06 research assessment (authority doc) establishes: Article 50(2) machine-readable marking became applicable 2026-08-02 (Omnibus left the date unchanged; grace to 2026-12-02 for systems on the market before then); the FOSS exemption does not cover Article 50 systems, so applicability hinges on whether free, unmonetized distribution is "placing on the market in the course of a commercial activity" — a genuine gray zone that thins toward App Store submission; Vocello outputs today carry zero marking (bare 44-byte WAV headers). MAINTAINER DECISION REQUIRED: adopt the "applicable-soon" posture or defer. Gated options from the assessment: (A) WAV metadata provenance chunk (small, backend); (B) C2PA manifest on export (medium); (C) AudioSeal-class imperceptible watermark (large; MLX/Swift port + 8 GB benchmark); (D) cloning-disclosure UX copy for users' own Article 50(4) duty (small; recommended unconditionally); (E) Code of Practice signature (maintainer-only, presumes provider status). The App Store submission runbook gains an Article 50 checklist row when any option lands. POSTURE UPDATE 2026-08-06 (maintainer): a one-time purchase is planned for Vocello. That resolves the commercial-activity question — Article 50(2) applies to the paid offering with certainty, and a newly monetized placing after 2026-08-02 gets no grace period, so marking is launch-gating for the paid release. Adopted sequence: options A (metadata chunk) + D (cloning-disclosure copy) gate the paid launch; option C (AudioSeal imperceptible watermark) proceeds now as the robustness layer via the CP-2 spike; B (C2PA) medium-term; E (Code of Practice) revisited with real legal advice before the paid launch. CLOSE 2026-08-08: the adopted sequence is executed as far as it reaches before the paid launch. Option A verified complete against the assessment's field set after adding the generator version to the provenance chunk (version= ICMT field + 'Vocello <version>' ISFT, resolved from the embedding process's bundle and omitted when unresolvable; covered by WAVProvenanceChunkTests). Option D landed: one disclosure sentence beside the consent gate on macOS (Settings caption) and iOS (caption under the Settings toggle row; identifiers untouched, zero UI-test impact per the coverage survey), plus a README Local-first-privacy bullet pair (marking statement + disclosure duty) and a website Limitations 'AI disclosure' entry (user duty only; the shipping 2.4.0 release predates the marking seam, so the site makes no marking claim). Recommendation 3 done: the submission runbook gained the Article 50 checklist row beside the EU DSA row and its DG-4 frontmatter annotation. REMAINING AND PAID-LAUNCH-GATED (deliberately not items yet): option B (C2PA manifest), option E (Code of Practice signature), and the real legal review; activate them when the paid-offering work starts.

items.title: AudioSeal watermark validation spike, then MLX-Swift port (option C)
items.gate: Maintainer go 2026-08-06 ('test and implement this now'). STAGE 1 PRE-REGISTERED acceptance criteria, fixed before any embedding run — Python validation on the banked 24 kHz bench-archive corpus using pinned audioseal + pinned HF weights, engine idle (8 GB rule): (1) DETECTION: detector TPR = 1.0 on marked and FPR = 0.0 on clean takes at the default 0.5 threshold across the corpus; (2) INAUDIBILITY PROXY: per-take analyze_delivery + analyze_prosody metric deltas between marked and unmarked within analyzer noise (no delivery/prosody gate flag changes), SI-SNR of the watermark delta >= 20 dB; (3) QC-PROXY NEUTRALITY: prosody_quality_gate verdicts unchanged marked vs unmarked on every take (the Swift Fast-QC neutrality proof lands with the port stage); (4) ROBUSTNESS through real share paths: detection still fires after afconvert AAC 128 kbps round-trip, 16 kHz resample, +/-3 dB gain, and a 1 s head trim; (5) DETERMINISM: repeated embedding of the same input is byte-identical; (6) PERFORMANCE: embed wall time faster than realtime on CPU with peak RSS recorded; (7) the model card's native-24 kHz claim verified (else the 16 kHz delta-resample design is recorded as required). STAGE 2 (on stage-1 pass): MLX-Swift port of the generator reusing the owned MLXAudioCodecs SEANet primitives, integrated as a deterministic post-process at the output-adapter publication seam, default-on for published WAVs, with memory-qualified benchmark evidence and Swift Fast-QC neutrality before any release. A stage-1 failure on any criterion is recorded honestly and stops stage 2 pending redesign. STAGE-1 RESULTS 2026-08-06 (run as registered; 24-take corpus: one full dp22 normal-tier run plus whisper/sad/angry/fearful strong takes; audioseal 0.2.0 pinned, generator 14.7M/detector 8.6M params, weights fetched from facebook/audioseal): ALL SEVEN CRITERIA PASS. (1) Detection TPR 1.0 (min marked prob 1.0), FPR 0.0 (max clean prob 0.032). (2) Inaudibility: SI-SNR min 25.5 dB / median 29.5 dB; worst per-take F0-median analyzer delta 4.3 Hz with zero delivery/prosody verdict changes. (3) QC-proxy neutrality: prosody gate parity on 24/24. (4) Robustness: worst detection 0.997 after AAC-64k mono round-trip, 1.0 after +/-3 dB gain, 0.984 after 1 s head trim; the 16 kHz chain reads 0.0 if detected at 16 kHz but 0.997+ under the standard verifier protocol of resampling suspect audio back to the 24 kHz embed rate — recorded as a required detection-protocol note for any verify tooling. (5) Deterministic embeds, byte-identical. (6) Performance: 14.5x realtime embedding on CPU (a 6 s take costs ~0.4 s); peak RSS 1.42 GB under PyTorch (the MLX port carries only 56 MB of weights). (7) Native 24 kHz embedding confirmed — no resample-delta design needed (AudioSeal 0.2 semantics: no internal resampling; rates must be handled explicitly). Stage 2 (MLX-Swift port at the output-adapter publication seam) proceeds per the registered gate. STAGE-2 DESIGN CONSTRAINTS 2026-08-06 (maintainer-blessed; motivated by the iPhone 14 Pro 6 GB opportunity the recent memory work opened): ZERO-PEAK design — the embedding pass runs at publication strictly AFTER the post-take cache trim, on the CPU stream (never GPU wired pages), in 1-2 s streaming chunks with carried conv state (working set ~40-55 MB incl. fp16 weights, unwired, freed at pass end), with lazy per-publication weight load-and-drop on 6 GB-class devices. The take lifecycle's peak footprint must be UNCHANGED: the qualification lane asserts peak equality with the pre-watermark baseline within sampler noise, fail-closed. Embedding during generation (AudioSeal streaming mode) is REJECTED with reason: it adds weights+state on top of the generation peak — the wrong direction for the 6 GB goal — accepting the residual costs instead: ~1-2 s iPhone file-ready latency post-take, 29 MB on-disk catalog asset, unmarked live preview (the published file is the legal boundary). fp16 weights require the added parity criterion (detector probability + SI-SNR hold at half precision) before adoption. STAGE-2 PROGRESS 2026-08-06 (pieces 1-2 landed, 2729ce4 + 5ba9c78): the MLX-Swift port is complete and parity-exact — MLXAudioMark target in the owned package (lineage MARK-001, capability audio-marking, state internal), whole-buffer output >=40 dB SNR against the PyTorch reference on protocol fixtures, and the shipping exact-streaming windowed path (windowed convs + full-sequence frame-rate LSTMs, bounded activations) >=55 dB against whole-buffer; the reference detector scores Swift-marked real Vocello speech 1.0000 (clean 0.001) with the fixed 0x56C0 payload decoding exactly at SI-SNR 29.6 dB. Design notes locked by evidence: naive per-window embedding with cold LSTMs degraded detection to 0.28-0.46 and was replaced by the exact decomposition; the upstream get_watermark API draws a random message per process, so the fixed payload is mandatory for determinism. Piece 2: WAVProvenanceChunk (LIST/INFO ISFT+ICMT machine-readable statement, RIFF-size patch, PCM untouched, read-back helper, five core tests) — built but deliberately not applied at publication yet. REMAINING (piece 3, next window): catalog delivery of the fused weights as a required shared component, publication-seam wiring (watermark then metadata then QC) flipping both marks together, registered debug knob for the dev path, memory-qualified macOS bench with peak-equality assertion, Swift Fast-QC live neutrality, docs; then iOS device acceptance queues with CM-5 for phone access. STAGE-2 COMPLETION 2026-08-07 (piece 3 landed): the publication seam is live — GenerationOutputAdapter marks every published WAV after staging finalization and before Fast QC judges the exact published bytes (AudioSeal watermark + LIST/INFO provenance chunk flip together; a sample-count change fails publication closed; long-form assembly appends only the chunk since segments arrive marked; the registered QWENVOICE_MARKING knob under the master gate is the sole off-switch, and the seam captures its telemetry boundaries only when marking executes so a knob-off run cannot present marking-shaped evidence). DESIGN AMENDMENTS earned empirically against the stage-2 constraints: the pass runs on the default Metal device, not CPU — MLX's CPU conv path measured ~1x realtime with ~300 MB per-window transients, while GPU transients are fully reclaimed post-take (gpuAllocatedMB byte-identical to pre-marking baselines at every post-trim boundary) — and the shipping exact-streaming window geometry is 64/8 core/margin, parity-proven >=55 dB. ZERO-PEAK EVIDENCE: the fail-closed gate is a WITHIN-TAKE assertion (config/marking-peak-equality.json + scripts/check_marking_peak_equality.py): no footprint sample at or after the marking interval may exceed that take's pre-marking peak (5%/48 MB), boundaries mandatory. Canonical clean-tree record mac-memory-qualification-20260807-022819-3eb4d25b: 11/11 takes PASS with the marking interval 500-1100 MB below each take's peak; the pass's own boundary delta measures +9 to +18 MB. INSTRUMENT NOTE recorded honestly: the originally designed cross-run lifecycle-peak comparison was refuted by its own QWENVOICE_MARKING=off control run, which failed the cross-run bound worse than the marked run in every mode — whole-lifecycle peaks on the 8 GB canonical host drift hundreds of MB with system memory pressure across back-to-back runs — so the gate measures the marking pass itself. QC NEUTRALITY: fixed-seed A/B (seed 4242, Speed/medium full-mode matrix), records macos-engine-20260807-023057-5275b724 (marked) vs macos-engine-20260807-023242-fce41fcb (knob off): 8/8 cells verdict parity with zero clip/discontinuity/non-finite deltas and dcOffset ~2e-4 (the watermark delta itself). SHIPPING-FILE ADJUDICATION: a real CLI take carries the machine-readable provenance statement and the pinned reference detector scores it 1.0000 with payload 0x56C0 decoding exactly; knob-off outputs score 0.011-0.034 with no chunk. REMAINING: the six HF weight uploads + catalog re-pin are staged and maintainer-gated (contract-side conditional uniformity enforcement already in model_catalog_contract.py; artifactVersion 2026.08.06.1 planned), and iOS device acceptance queues for the next phone window.
